title: pnpm cache: select store-dir env var based on pnpm version
body:

#### pnpm cache: select store-dir env var based on pnpm version

pnpm v11+ reads config from PNPM_CONFIG_* env vars, while older versions
read from NPM_CONFIG_*. The previous fix only set PNPM_CONFIG_STORE_DIR,
so the cache redirect did not apply for pnpm <11.

Pick the store-dir env key (PNPM_CONFIG_STORE_DIR vs NPM_CONFIG_STORE_DIR)
based on the detected pnpm version, and use it consistently for both the
user-override check and the redirect write.
